Simplified Chinese: 哎呀呀！这又是哪门子的海怪，伙计们？

Simplified Chinese: 哈哈，尝到厉害了吧！伙计们，今晚吃炸鱿鱼圈！

Simplified Chinese: 噗噜，噗噜……我高兴得连自己都喷黑啦！噗噜！

Simplified Chinese: 哎哟，伙计们！咱们可惹上了一群横行的家伙！

Simplified Chinese: 胡子留好了！咔嚓，咔嚓……我要开剪啦！
哈哈，伙计们！这回连壳都给他们吓软啦！

Simplified Chinese: 喂，伙计们！我闻见了……好大一股鱼腥味！

Simplified Chinese: 哈哈，轻而易举！不过嘛，大海里的鱼可多着呢！
都站住！现在是……铁头锤时间！

English source: Arrrgh!... Who be a pretty|boy then? ...Does Polly|want a cracker?
Simplified Chinese: 哟，谁是漂亮的小乖乖呀？波莉，要不要块饼干？

English source: Squawk!... Who's a pretty|boy then? ...Squawk!...|Polly want a cracker!|...Squawk!
Simplified Chinese: 嘎！谁是漂亮的小乖乖？嘎！波莉要饼干！嘎！

English source: Arrrgh... 'tiz a shame.|They could have made fine|shoulder enhancers.
Simplified Chinese: 唉，可惜啦！本来还能给咱们肩膀添点风光呢！
嘎！波莉要饼干！

English source: Guard the fruit mateys...|If the monkeys get it we'll|be up for another bout|of scurvy!
Simplified Chinese: 守住水果，伙计们！叫猴子抢了去，坏血病又得找上门啦！

English source: Yarrgh! Yer monkey business|ain't foolin' any of us!
Simplified Chinese: 哈！少耍猴戏啦！咱们可没那么好糊弄！

English source: These boys look too clean|to be in a real fight! And|look... they've still got|teeth to knock out!

Simplified Chinese: 为国王和国家而战！当然，还有优厚的福利……和退休金！

English source: They don't look so smart|now lads... I think We'll|be using his toupee to swab|the decks!
Simplified Chinese: 瞧，还神气吗？伙计们，拿他的假发擦甲板去！

English source: You pirates will get what|you deserve... a short drop|and a sudden stop!
Simplified Chinese: 海盗们，报应来啦！绳圈一套，脚下一空……就此告别！

English source: Yargh... These guys have|one too many eye patches!|This should be easy! Let's|get 'em!
Simplified Chinese: 哈！他们的眼罩也太多啦！伙计们，这回闭着眼都能赢！

English source: Get who? Where am I...|how did I get here?
Simplified Chinese: 赢谁？我在哪儿？哎，我怎么跑到这儿来了？
哈哈！咱们这招，可真叫他们看不见啊！

English source: Gar... I can't hear them...|Does anyone know if we|won?
Simplified Chinese: 哎，怎么没声啦？谁告诉我……咱们赢了吗？

Simplified Chinese: 哟呵，伙计们！瞧瞧，眼前可都是上好的“宝贝”呀！

Simplified Chinese: 哼！你能捞着的“宝贝”，就只有本姑娘这一脚！

English source: Arrgh... shame... what a|waste of such lovely|sea legs!
Simplified Chinese: 唉，真可惜！白瞎了这么漂亮的水手腿！

English source: Yarp... Everybody knows|girls are better than boys!
Simplified Chinese: 哈！这还用说？姑娘们就是比小伙子强！

English source: Arrrrggggh... I think we|found some old sea dogs!|Ready for retirement!
Simplified Chinese: 哟呵，一群老海狗！各位，该上岸养老啦！

English source: We're not Old, we're|experienced... and now we're|gonna kick your... erm...|erm... what was I saying|again... who are you?
Simplified Chinese: 老？这叫经验！瞧我踢你们的……呃，说到哪儿了？你是谁？

English source: Garrrrgh! Ok, Grandads...|time for your afternoon|nap!
Simplified Chinese: 好啦，老爷子们！午睡时间到，乖乖闭眼吧！

Simplified Chinese: 哎哟，真威风呀！可你还不知道？五彩缤纷才是新潮流！

English source: I'd have beaten you sooner if|your fancy beards didn't|keep catchin' the light!
Simplified Chinese: 要不是你们的花胡子晃得我眼花，早就收拾完啦！

English source: Oo-er! Now we're finished|with them, it's time for a|bit of retail therapy!

English source: Yarrgh! ...ye be wanting to|grow a proper beard before|taking on the likes of us,|boys...
Simplified Chinese: 小家伙们，想跟咱们较量？先长出一把像样的胡子吧！

Simplified Chinese: 我才不是小孩！上个月下巴就长了两根毛！不信问我妈妈！

English source: Yarrgh! Best be running|along home now boys! I think|it be past yer bedtime?
Simplified Chinese: 回家去吧，小家伙们！早过了你们的睡觉时间啦！

English source: Get the cookin' pot ready...|pirate stew tonight!

English source: Good work lads! we've|avoided being lunch... looks|like they'll have to stick|with mangos and coconuts|from now on!

English source: mmmmmmm! can't remember|the last time we had a good|pirate stew!|...has anyone got the salt?
Simplified Chinese: 嗯……好久没尝过海盗炖汤啦！哎，谁把盐递过来？

English source: This crew looks like they|could do with a good feed|more than a fight...
Simplified Chinese: 瞧这一船伙计！他们缺的不是一场架，是一顿饱饭！

English source: you'll have to catch us all|first ...fatty!
Simplified Chinese: 先追得上我们再说吧……胖墩儿！

Simplified Chinese: 戴那种帽子还想赢？等我赢了，你们的帽子也全归我！

English source: I think he was a little|hot-headed...|maybe it was his hat!
Simplified Chinese: 瞧他那副火冒三丈的样子！八成是帽子捂得太热啦！

English source: These hats 'll be a mighty|fine addition to my|collection!
